comments.author: ArnArn
comments.body:
I got this from one of the comments in cooking skills. Posting it here

Quest Name : "The Lovely Sweet Shop" 7 Star Quest.
Quest Location : Lisbon , Merchant Guild - Merchant Mediator
Req : Cooking R10 , Portuguese Language , Trade fame 50.000 - 250.0000
Quest summary : Take 50 Baumkuchen to Christina on lisbon tavern , in 20 days.

"The Lovely Sweet Shop" Quest Reward : "Renowned Patissier's recipe book" cooking book.

This is also a pre-quest to get the "Patissier" Job (expert in cooking).
